pages.draft_excerpt: This self-report assessment organizes answers into Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. Use the result as a structured hypothesis for reflection, not a diagnosis, fixed identity, or decision about eligibility. Backend product truth currently marks the assessment entry as free-only and lists summary, domain overview, and disclaimers as free sections. Separate backend entitlement records define conditional full-report and action-plan modules. Availability and any offer must be resolved by the live backend; this content package embeds no price and makes no universal unlock promise.

这项自陈测评把回答组织为开放性、尽责性、外倾性、宜人性和神经质五个宽泛维度。结果适合用作可检验的反思假设，不是诊断、固定身份或资格判断。 backend product truth 当前把测评入口标记为 free-only，并把摘要、domain 总览和免责声明列为免费 sections；另有 entitlement 记录定义条件性的完整报告与行动计划模块。具体可用内容和 offer 必须由 live backend 决定，本内容包不嵌入价格，也不承诺统一解锁。
